name: decode_preserves_field_order
description: Tabular decode must reconstruct each row object in the declared field-union order, not sorted. Fields z,a,m are non-alphabetical so a decoder that rebuilds objects into an unordered map (re-encoding lexicographically as a,m,z) fails the round-trip. Object key ordering is a preserved round-trip property (SPEC lines 52, 931).
